title: Home page — the site as it is today

callouts.text: The menu. Donate is now Giving, Community Outreach has moved under it as Serving Others, and a new Education & Resources section has been added.
A generic icon of St John. Replaced with a more fitting one. Still to do: photograph our own icon and use that.
Unused space inside the red band. It now carries our service times — Vespers, the Hours, the Divine Liturgy, Evening Prayers — driving directions, and what is coming up in the next week.
The address, in small type in the footer, and nothing else. The home page now shows the address, where we are relative to I-490, and a working link to driving directions.
